scope: Selected technical fields from the earlier ring-buffer lifetime manifest. These are reported historical outcomes, not new observations or actual BTF kfunc lifetime evidence.
mechanism: A successful acquisition receives a newly kmalloc-allocated, 16-byte-aligned cell. Successful cells are deliberately never freed or reused in this experiment.
The BPF-visible value is an exact read-only cell handle; the hidden c6 value is an exact private cell handle. The object capability is stored in the cell.
Register copies and the one verifier-typed full-width spill/reload carry the cell handle, not direct object authority.
The supported spill uses one exact private 16-byte c8 sidecar slot outside BPF stack authority.
Use resolves object authority into c5, performs one checked access, then clears c5 in an exact checker-recognized sequence.
Release clears c5, clears the cell, and only then invokes ring-buffer submit/discard. Cell clearing is the release linearization point for Property 2.
No register, stack, or alias scan occurs.
The direct-capability causal control bypasses cell mediation and is accepted only as one exact test profile.

limits: The four controls use a ring-buffer acquire/release analogue. They do not establish actual Linux BTF KF_ACQUIRE/KF_RELEASE behavior, independent A/B acquisitions, double-release effects or a destructor count.
The exact profiles deliberately skip constant blinding even though bpf_jit_harden=2 was enabled at runtime.

One private full-width spill is supported. Exact final native templates, restricted untagged RDDC, non-reentrancy and confinement of handles are premises; no shared map, subprogram, tail-call, persistent or cross-CPU transport is covered.
Successful cells were deliberately not freed or reused. General reclamation and concurrency are outside the result.
Object authority and trusted transition plumbing originate from executive DDC. Provider assignment and bounds remain trusted, not allocator-authenticated.
Trusted compiler and exception frames can retain tagged transient capabilities. Global physical erasure is not established.
Runs used Morello QEMU. No independent userspace ring-buffer-consumer oracle, physical Morello measurement or current protected-BPF stale-failure execution follows from these records.
Only the manifest source was inspected for this selection. Referenced original logs, native artifacts and transitive hashes were not rerun or independently validated.
